sentence_stem: If I had studied medicine at university,
correct_completion: I would be a doctor by now.
full_sentence: If I had studied medicine at university, I would be a doctor by now.
acceptable_variants: I would be working as a doctor now.
I would probably be a doctor today.

options.text: I will be a doctor tomorrow.
options.why_wrong: 'Will' expresses a real future possibility. It does not fit an unreal past condition such as 'If I had studied medicine'.

options.text: I would be a doctor by now.

options.why_wrong: This states a plain fact and ignores the conditional structure set up by 'if'.

options.text: I would have been a doctor last year.
options.why_wrong: This points to a past result, but 'by now' signals that the result refers to the present, so the mixed conditional needs a present-time result.

grammar_focus: Mixed conditionals: past unreal condition with present unreal result
explanation: The 'if' clause describes an unreal past situation using the past perfect, while the main clause describes its unreal present result using 'would' with a present-time marker. Portuguese speakers may find this mixed pattern harder because they often keep the same tense in both clauses.
translation: Se eu tivesse estudado medicina na faculdade, eu seria médico agora.
